## **18.2 Getting Started**

```{r}
pacman::p_load(sf, tidyverse, MCI, tmap, ggstatsplot)
```

## **18.3 Importing Data**

```{r}
stores <- st_read(
  dsn = "data/geospatial",
  layer = "STORES_TC")
```

```{r}
town <- st_read(
  dsn = "data/geospatial",
  layer = "TOWN_TC")
```

```{r}
village <- st_read(
  dsn = "data/geospatial",
  layer = "VILLAGE_TC")
```

::: callout-note
The output print above shown that the three data sets are in **TWD97 / TM2 zone 121 (i.e epsg: 3826)**projected coordinates systems.
:::

```{r}
tmap_mode("view")
tm_shape(town) +
  tm_polygons() +
tm_shape(village) +
  tm_polygons() + 
tm_shape(stores) +
  tm_dots()
```
